# Tech Engi

> Tech Engi (techengi.in) is India's AI-matched freelance network for bug fixing and engineering work. Clients post a bug, feature or project; an AI (LLM) matches it to a verified engineer by project title, description, tech stack, skills and budget; and an experienced human engineer does the work. AI matches. Humans fix. Tech Engi is a platform of TSquareY1 OPC Private Limited, a DPIIT- and MSME-recognised startup based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, founded by Tarun Patak K.

Key facts:

- Focus: bug fixing first, especially for corporate teams; also CRM, ERP, SaaS, AI development, embedded systems and IoT.
- How it works for clients: post the requirement, pay 25% upfront to confirm, get matched by AI, track progress live, pay by milestone through escrow.
- Co-worker for a day: a verified engineer works through your agreed task list for one working day for ₹3,480.
- For engineers: no bidding, no tokens or credits, no profile ranking, no fee to close a deal. Engineers keep 97% of what the client pays on their first project and 95% on every project after.
- Tech Engi Pro: optional ₹734 plan for engineers that sends client leads by email. Escrow protection applies only to work run through the Tech Engi dashboard.
- Verification: engineers submit Aadhaar, PAN and proof of experience before taking work.
- Who it's for: corporate teams and managers, QA testers, debuggers, junior/senior/full-stack/MERN developers, freshers, students (help with their own projects), startups and founders.
- Tagline: "Tech Engi — where engineers build without overhead."

## Start

- [About Tech Engi](https://techengi.in/about): what Tech Engi is, how it works, pricing, verification and company details
- [Post a bug or project](https://techengi.in/register/client): for clients, founders and companies
- [Join as an engineer](https://techengi.in/register/engineer): for developers, QA testers and freelancers
